welcome_copy: Describe the task in plain language. Quill will inspect the workspace, propose actions, and ask before doing anything that needs your permission.
prompt_project: Inspect my workspace and briefly explain what files and folders it contains.
prompt_skills: List the available skills and explain what each one is for.
prompt_file: Create a file named hello.txt with a short greeting.
prompt_security: Explain the safety restrictions in this build.
settings_subtitle: Configure the interface, models, and Quill's operating rules in one place.
appearance_desc: Make the interface yours. Changes apply immediately.
language_card_desc: Language used for menus, messages, and hints.
accent_card_desc: Color for active elements, highlights, and buttons.
provider_section_desc: Add different APIs, keep provider profiles locally, and switch models in a few clicks.
provider_rail_note: One profile means one endpoint and one model. API keys are never written to disk.
provider_key_placeholder: Enter a key for this session
key_note_new: The key will not be written to disk. You can add it later.
key_note_existing: A key is already in memory. Leave this field empty to keep it unchanged.
key_note_missing: No key is set for this profile yet. It will stay in application memory only.
key_note_clear: The API key will be removed from memory when you save this profile.
tool_guide_note: The tool-control guide is added separately and automatically.
confirm_file_changes_desc: Quill will ask before writing or deleting files.
unsaved_settings: Changes are applied only after you save the profile.
profile_delete_confirm: Delete the “{name}” profile? Its API key will also be forgotten.
discard_changes_confirm: You have unsaved provider changes. Leave without saving?
discard_new_confirm: Discard unsaved changes and create a new profile?
discard_profile_confirm: Discard unsaved changes to the current profile?
save_before_clear_key: Save the profile to clear its API key.
profile_active_status: Profile saved and set as active.
profile_fill_hint: Enter the endpoint and model. Profile settings will be saved locally.
provider_selected_hint: Profile selected. Changes will apply when you save.
key_session_hint: The key is required for requests and stays in application memory only.
settings_provider_add_first: Add your first provider in Settings.
security_section_desc: What the agent is allowed to do in this build.
security_commands_desc: Disabled until OS-level process isolation is implemented.
security_skills_desc: Skills load on demand; Python is not executed automatically.
err_base_url: Base URL must start with http:// or https://.
err_url_credentials: Do not put credentials directly in the URL.
err_provider_save: Could not save the provider profile.
err_no_active_provider: Add and activate a provider in Settings first.
err_no_api_key: No API key for the active provider. Add one in Settings or set LLQUILL_API_KEY.
err_app_not_running: Launch the app with main.py to connect the Python API.
shell_unavailable: Command execution is disabled until an OS sandbox is available.
saved_key_memory: A key is in memory. Leave this field empty to keep it unchanged.
saved_no_key: No key is set for this profile yet. It will stay in application memory only.
provider_delete_key_note: Its API key will also be forgotten.
approve_file_write: Write or replace “{path}” inside the workspace?
approve_file_delete: Delete “{path}” inside the workspace? Quill cannot undo this deletion.
action_rejected: The user rejected the action or the approval timed out.
permission_denied: The operation is blocked by workspace policy.
run_step_limit: The agent reached the step limit for this task.
approval_request_gone: This approval request is no longer active.
